name: oncall
description: On-call: each alert, keyed by its service, gets a proposed remediation from a triage agent and goes to the on-call person. A newer alert for the same service makes the waiting ask stale: the desk withdraws it, an answer to it is refused, and the new ask takes its place. Decisions do not outlive the situation they were about.

neurons.description: Alerts, keyed by service: a newer one replaces an older one for the same service.
The triage agent: proposes one remediation per alert.
Kit, on call: do it, or hold.
Carries out the call. An effect.
